events.name: CCI Western India Squash Championship
events.venue: Cricket Club of India (Anil Nayar squash complex), Brabourne Stadium, Churchgate
events.organiser: Cricket Club of India, under SRFI and the Maharashtra Squash Racquets Association
events.registration_notes: Entry through the SRFI online system. Rs 1,000 per category.
events.summary: India's oldest squash tournament, first held in 1943, and a 4-star SRFI national circuit event at CCI's six glass-backed courts. Draws cover juniors, men's and women's open, pro coaches and masters age groups from 35+ to 65+. Past champions include Saurav Ghosal and Joshna Chinappa.

categories.eligibility: Age group as per SRFI junior rules
categories.notes: U-11, U-13, U-15, U-17 and U-19 draws for boys and girls.

course.description: Six glass-backed courts at the Anil Nayar squash complex inside CCI's Brabourne Stadium in south Mumbai.

events.format: Knockout draws per category on the SRFI national circuit, rated 4-star for junior, senior and masters ranking points. Junior events add playoffs for the top 8 places.
highlights: 4-star ranking points in junior, senior and masters draws
tips: Entries close on 3 November, five weeks before play
CCI is a short walk from Churchgate station; take the train rather than driving into south Mumbai
Check draw timings on the SRFI site each evening; schedules shift as junior rounds run long

events.registration_notes: 2026 entries ran 4 to 19 December 2025 on the SRFI system. Rs 1,000 per category.

events.name: Goa Squash Masters
events.venue: SAG squash courts, SAG Sports Complex, Chicalim (near Vasco da Gama)
events.organiser: SRFI national circuit event (local organiser not named in the SRFI listing)

events.summary: Masters-only squash tournament in Goa on the SRFI national circuit, rated 5-star in both 2025 (28-30 March) and 2026 (10-12 April). Draws run from 35+ to 70+ for men and 35+ for women.
